claim: Opening: conatus is the drive of every being to persist in its own nature and to increase its power to act — 'not static preservation' but 'active self-maintenance.' § The Affects: Joy and Sadness: joy is the affect that accompanies an increase in power-to-act, sadness a decrease; hilaritas is 'a joy that affects the whole body/mind equally, not just one part.' § Cross-Domain Mirrors: 'Coupling doesn't destroy conatus; it harmonizes multiple conatus into collective coherence … each entity's conatus is amplified, not overridden.'

pieces.what: Persisting versus striving: a thing that only holds its state (a ball in a bowl) beside a thing that maintains itself actively (an agent that spends effort to restore and extend its own range). The reader perturbs both; the static one returns or is lost, the striving one returns and reaches further. Tests the opening's distinction by a number — reachable states, or recovery after a push — and says before the run what number would mean the distinction is empty.
pieces.walks_up_from: a ball in a bowl, pushed once

pieces.what: Power-to-act as a measured quantity across several parts of one body; joy and sadness as its change; hilaritas as an increase spread over every part against titillatio as an increase in one. The piece plots the distribution and tests whether 'whole body equally' is a measurable difference (spread across parts) and not only a label — including the case the text implies: a large one-part gain that leaves the whole weaker.

The Kuramoto mirror run as a test: each oscillator's conatus is its natural frequency; couple them, let them lock, then uncouple and measure what each returns to. 'Coupling doesn't destroy conatus' predicts the natural frequencies come back unchanged; 'amplified, not overridden' is tested against the strong-coupling regime where one voice dominates (the palace's own Kuramoto page says too much coupling and one voice dominates — the piece must build that situation before confirming or refuting the mirror). Number that would mean failure stated first.
pieces.walks_up_from: one oscillator, uncoupled, keeping its own time
